scripts.dev: concurrently -n site,student,teacher -c yellow,green,blue "npm run dev -w @lemmory/site" "npm run dev -w @lemmory/student" "npm run dev -w @lemmory/teacher"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lemmory/site && npm run build -w @lemmory/student && npm run build -w @lemmory/teacher
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lemmory/site && npm run lint -w @lemmory/student && npm run lint -w @lemmory/teacher
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/site && tsc --noEmit -p apps/student && tsc --noEmit -p apps/teacher
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
